plan: Define CheckInConsole class with __init__ storing appointments copy, session dict, and optional source/sink.
Implement handle(action) to validate action type and fields, update session per state machine, and return screen dict.
Implement screen builder that computes prompt, messages, and choices based on session state.
Implement run_once() to require source and sink, read action, handle it, display screen, and return screen.
Ensure invalid actions produce Error screen without mutating session.
Write solution.py with all required methods and imports.
mechanisms: State machine with explicit session fields (active, contact_confirmed, appointment_id, completed).
Action validation via type checks and field presence/type checks.
Screen builder function that derives prompt from session state and unmet requirements.
Appointment choices only when prompt is 'Choose appointment'.
Error handling that returns screen with first message starting 'Error:' and leaves session unchanged.
run_once() enforces source/sink presence and single display call.
